# Intro
What is the central question that motivates your analysis? Who may this analysis
benefit? Are you trying to train a model, test a hypothesis, classify objects apart? Why? This has to
be written with proper grammar and syntax: sentences, paragraphs, and a narrative structure.

- The question we are seeking to answer is whether income has an effect on disease. Will median household income show a correlation to disease proclivity? This information would be beneficial in creating policy to target decreasing disease in populations who are affected more and prevention in populations who aren't. Alternatively, certain companies and investors may be able to benefit from such a relationship being found by allowing insight into the likelihood of certain investments succeeding in a population due to their proximity to disease and their relative wealth.

To realize these possible benefits, we are creating correlation maps using publicly available data on the incomes of household in the US and comparing these numbers to CDC estimates from 2025 for health status.
